scope: All 136 V2 ALERT records returned across all five supported regimes; 120 unique mints. Earlier alerts absent from V2, other bots and complete Telegram history not verified.
evidence_limitations: Sequential live queries are not an atomic database snapshot.
Market-cap multiples are sampled observations, not execution returns.
Unequal observation windows; ACTIVE cases are unfinished.
Legacy peak labels are diagnostic only; no fixed-horizon win rate inferred.
Full timed-outcome rows and entry features unavailable through current read tools; direct DB access denied.
Policy changed on 2026-10-03; pooled historical records do not validate current admission policy.

rules.instruction: Key tokens by chain and mint, never symbol. Multiple UDR and POOPYBOT identities exist.
Report event-level and first-alert-per-mint outcomes separately; never treat escalation alerts as independent token successes.
Always pair sampled peak with last observation and adverse excursion. Never call a peak multiple a realized return or profitable trade.
Existing label() chooses peak categories before failure. A 2X/5X label can coexist with a near-total subsequent collapse. Do not use label as a binary success target.
Use fixed horizons and timestamp-valid outcomes (lateness 0..180 seconds). Require complete within-horizon coverage for peak rates. Missing outcomes remain missing; do not backfill using global ATH.
Keep token controls, liquidity controls and verified sell receipts mandatory. Explicit REJECT in any check blocks. Background UNKNOWN may pass admission but must remain visible.
KIN triggered at score 8 with pc5 -14.8% and band 124%; logs show ~0.7755x at 1m, ~0.6269x at 5m, ~0.8345x at 15m. Do not describe as clean compression or generalize causality from one case.

Evaluate existing band<=25% and pc5>=-5% as mandatory quality gates in shadow. Compare missed winners and adverse outcomes at identical horizons on mint-separated later data. Do not promote from this audit.
Evaluate predefined partial-profit and downside scenarios only with ordered price observations, liquidity, fees and slippage. Never infer target-before-stop ordering from max/min alone.

Freeze candidate rules before later forward evaluation, stratify by policy era, separate ALERT/SHADOW, preserve baseline. No production rule changes or model-weight training are implied by this knowledge file.
